distribution.narrative: 黄复生等 (2015) records Eidophelus darwini from Yunnan. Lin & Beaver (2021) adds the first Taiwan record, based on one female from Yuchi Township, Nantou. The reviewed synthesis therefore treats mainland China (Yunnan) and Taiwan as present.

host_note: 黄复生等 (2015) gives only the vague host term '藤'. Lin & Beaver (2021) cites Cryptolepis buchanani and Parameria barbata from earlier literature, but the Taiwan specimen was trap-caught. These host data are retained in the historical/source-evidence layer rather than promoted as a direct current host synthesis.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Eidophelus darwini (Eichhoff, 1878).
